newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha gains $1-2, piggy-backs gasoline.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha gains $1-2, piggy-backs gasoline.

text.p: NWE naphtha was $1-2 a tonne stronger on Wednesday in the slipstream of surging gasoline prices, dealers said.
The fundementals of the market were unchanged with tightish supplies matched by a reluctance of end-users to get drawn into an upward spiral in prices.
August swaps were around $191 and cif cargoes in NWE were assessed around $193-194.
Market awareness of fresh supplies of gasoline in NWE from August 15 has tempered buyers onwards rush to get onto the bandwagon.
"Buying naphtha high now to produce gasoline later, which would attract a lower price than today is of concern," said one.
